public_notes.title: A Living Community And Long Relationships
public_notes.text: The Tribe introduces Tyme Maidu relationships with the land and water of present-day Butte County as extending since time immemorial. This is its account of continuity, not a dated founding claim or a map of legal ownership. Its public homepage also records a community handgame tournament held in June 2022. This profile concerns Berry Creek Rancheria's government and community; it does not stand in for every Maidu people or government.

public_notes.title: Education Through The Tribe's Own Resources
public_notes.text: The Tribe's education page gathers assistance information, college connections and scholarship resources for Tribal members. Follow those own-source links to understand the programs on their own terms. Listings can carry dated deadlines and eligibility conditions; this profile does not promise that an application is open or that funding is available. The page is a route to the Tribe's information, not a substitute for its decisions.
